verdict.rationale: Jeeves docs explicitly describe per-card spend limits ('Adjust spend limits instantly', 'Cap employees' spend with card controls and custom limits'), plus granular controls including custom roles/permissions, embedded expense policies, and per-card MCP management of spending limits and reset intervals. This directly matches the finance-lead persona's need to set per-employee card limits and controls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and detail on granularity (e.g., category-level restrictions, MCC blocking).
